design_summary: Structural game-design work for The Ultimate Muffin: overworld progression gating, varied tower level design, a dungeon-maze tower variant, ambient wildlife migration, and the cross-cutting composition refactor of the character system. These efforts shape how the world is structured, how players progress through it, and how combatant code is organized.

standalone_designs.title: Wildlife Migration Patterns
standalone_designs.summary: Cyclic multi-phase migration system that compels species (fireflies, bats) toward the nearest active destination zone, then returns them to normal behavior on arrival. Includes a per-species pattern model, a level-config JSON schema, and a MIGRATION level-editor mode.
standalone_designs.source: docs/design/migration_patterns.md; git: 'Implement migration patterns: cyclic multi-phase species movement' (2026-03-18), 'Migration: per-species patterns, stagger, bat repulsion, editor polish'

standalone_designs.title: Unified Character Composition Architecture
standalone_designs.summary: Refactor the 9.6K-line player_side.gd and the enemy system into one composition-based Character base with node FSMs, components, Resource-backed config, and swappable ClassComponents, where the only player/enemy distinction is the attached InputController. Phases 1-5 (foundation, movement/action FSMs, simple and complex class extraction) shipped; full enemy migration and player_side.gd deletion are not yet complete.
standalone_designs.source: docs/design/player_refactor.md; git: 'Refactor Phase 1+2: Foundation classes, FSM, components, resources, object pool' (2026-04-01), 'Release v0.10.41 — Composition refactor phases 3-5', 'Release v0.10.46 — ChargeComponent, Character virtuals, player_side.gd under 4K'

standalone_designs.title: Test Runner, Player & Gameplay Systems Overhaul (v0.10.18-23)
standalone_designs.summary: Six-release build log covering the docked test editor with three editor modes, script-hash result caching, generic entity selection, and gameplay/player additions (chain daze, soccer dummy, balloon chain explosions, press-to-join controllers, debug-aspect migration). All six releases shipped.
